author: CNN
description:
In 2021, former Rep. Marjorie Taylor Greene took office, staking her political career fighting for President Trump and the MAGA agenda, at times clashing with those across the aisle and within her own party.

In later years, Greene became disillusioned with Trump and eventually broke with the president, claiming he abandoned the America First policies he campaigned on. She also has become more reflective on some of her past incindiary remarks. We look back on the evolution of Greene’s relationship with Trump and her views.

0:00 “We need to separate by red states and blue states”
1:09 Defending herself in court over claims that the 2020 election “was stolen”
2:27 Equating white supremacist label to “N-word”
5:05 Attacking Jasmine Crockett
7:18 “Do you represent science, Dr. Fauci?”
8:26 Calling Trump’s first Iran operation a “bait and switch”
9:44 Warns of “big blowback” over handling of Epstein case
11:06 Trump pulls his endorsement of MTG
11:51 She responds to Trump taking back his
title: MTG's transformation: From Trump loyalist to Trump critic
